title: Virgo 重力波干涉儀~Virgo gravitational-wave interferometer
focus: 3 km 干涉儀的低頻工程：超級衰減器、倒立擺、熱補償、牛頓雜訊、牛頓校正器與超高真空~Low-frequency engineering of a 3 km interferometer: superattenuator, inverted pendulum, thermal compensation, Newtonian noise, Newtonian calibrator and ultra-high vacuum
summary: 以義大利卡希納 EGO 的 Advanced Virgo 為對象，從 3 km 臂腔的自由光譜範圍與線寬出發，解析卡希納近海站址的地震雜訊為何需要約 9 m 高、以倒立擺預隔離的超級衰減器，42 kg 熔融石英鏡的熱透鏡如何用 CO₂ 雷射補償，牛頓雜訊、牛頓校正器與 1.2 m 真空管殘氣如何進入靈敏度預算，以及三站網路的天區定位與運行交接。~Using Advanced Virgo at EGO in Cascina, Italy, this course starts from the free spectral range and linewidth of 3 km arm cavities, explains why the seismic noise of the near-coastal Cascina site demands a superattenuator about 9 m tall with inverted-pendulum pre-isolation, how the thermal lens in 42 kg fused-silica mirrors is compensated with CO₂ lasers, how Newtonian noise, the Newtonian calibrator and residual gas in the 1.2 m vacuum tubes enter the sensitivity budget, and how three-detector sky localisation and run handoff are organised.

units.anchor: 3 km 臂腔與自由光譜範圍~3 km arm cavities and free spectral range
units.title: 3 km 臂的共振參數與應變尺度~Resonance parameters and strain scale of 3 km arms
units.mechanism: Virgo 是臂長 3 km 的功率循環 Fabry–Pérot 麥克森干涉儀，兩臂互相垂直，1064 nm 雷射在分光鏡分成兩束，臂端鏡把光送回分光鏡在輸出埠以暗紋干涉。臂腔的自由光譜範圍由臂長決定，線寬由精細度決定，腔極點則是訊號響應開始下降的頻率；臂長 3 km 而非 4 km，表示在相同精細度與功率下，對同一應變的相位訊號小 25%，因此 Virgo 的設計更倚重低頻隔振與高功率來補償。~Virgo is a power-recycled Fabry–Pérot Michelson interferometer with perpendicular 3 km arms; a 1064 nm laser is split at the beam splitter and the end mirrors return the light to interfere on a dark fringe at the output port. The free spectral range of an arm cavity is set by its length, the linewidth by its finesse and the cavity pole is the frequency where signal response begins to fall; arms of 3 km rather than 4 km mean that for the same finesse and power the phase signal from a given strain is 25% smaller, so the Virgo design leans harder on low-frequency isolation and high power to compensate.
units.model: 自由光譜範圍 FSR = c/(2L) = 3×10⁸/6000 = 50 kHz；精細度 F ≈ 450 時線寬 FSR/F ≈ 111 Hz，腔極點 f_p = c/(4LF) = 3×10⁸/(4×3000×450) ≈ 56 Hz。應變 h = 3.3×10⁻²² 對應 ΔL = h·L ≈ 1×10⁻¹⁸ m，約為質子直徑的千分之一。散粒雜訊應變正比於 1/(F·L)，故同精細度、同功率下 3 km 臂的散粒雜訊比 4 km 臂高 4/3 ≈ 1.33 倍。~Free spectral range FSR = c/(2L) = 3×10⁸/6000 = 50 kHz; with finesse F ≈ 450 the linewidth is FSR/F ≈ 111 Hz and the cavity pole f_p = c/(4LF) = 3×10⁸/(4×3000×450) ≈ 56 Hz. A strain h = 3.3×10⁻²² corresponds to ΔL = h·L ≈ 1×10⁻¹⁸ m, about one thousandth of a proton diameter. Shot-noise strain scales as 1/(F·L), so at equal finesse and power 3 km arms carry 4/3 ≈ 1.33 times the shot noise of 4 km arms.
units.verify: 以雷射頻率掃描臂腔，記錄透射峰的間距與寬度：峰距應為 50 kHz、峰寬約 111 Hz，由此得到實際精細度；再以已知的末端鏡驅動做掃頻，量差動臂長到輸出訊號的轉移函數，確認腔極點在 56 Hz 附近且與精細度一致。~Sweep the laser frequency across an arm cavity and record the spacing and width of the transmission peaks: the spacing should be 50 kHz and the width about 111 Hz, giving the actual finesse; then drive an end mirror with a swept sine and measure the transfer function from differential arm length to the output signal, confirming a cavity pole near 56 Hz consistent with the finesse.
units.failure: 若臂腔內的散射或吸收損耗升高使精細度從 450 掉到 300，線寬變寬、訊號增益下降三分之一，同時功率循環增益也降低；靈敏度曲線整體上移，但單看雷射與鎖定狀態不會顯示異常。~If scatter or absorption loss inside an arm raises and the finesse drops from 450 to 300, the linewidth broadens, the signal gain falls by a third and the power-recycling gain drops as well; the whole sensitivity curve shifts up while laser and lock status show nothing unusual.
units.misconception: 臂長 3 km 與 4 km 的差別只是場地大小，與靈敏度無關。~The difference between 3 km and 4 km arms is only site size, not sensitivity.

units.anchor: 卡希納站址地震計與海洋微震~Cascina seismometers and ocean microseism
units.title: 地震雜訊與低頻隔振需求~Seismic noise and the low-frequency isolation requirement
units.mechanism: 卡希納位於比薩附近的平原、距海岸不遠，地面在 0.2–0.5 Hz 的海洋微震振幅達微米等級，在 10 Hz 附近約 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz，且隨天氣與人類活動變化。重力波頻帶從約 10 Hz 開始，而測試質量在 10 Hz 允許的運動只有 10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz 等級，所以隔振系統必須提供十個數量級的衰減，並且在遠低於 10 Hz 的地方就開始生效；這就是 Virgo 從一開始便把低頻性能當作核心設計目標、發展超級衰減器的原因。~Cascina lies on the plain near Pisa not far from the coast; ground motion from ocean microseism at 0.2–0.5 Hz reaches micrometre amplitudes, near 10 Hz it is about 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz, and it varies with weather and human activity. The gravitational-wave band starts near 10 Hz, where the test mass may move only at the 10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz level, so the isolation must provide ten orders of magnitude of attenuation and must start acting far below 10 Hz; this is why Virgo made low-frequency performance a core design goal from the outset and developed the superattenuator.
units.model: 所需衰減 A = x_ground/x_allowed = 10⁻⁹/10⁻¹⁹ = 10¹⁰（10 Hz）。單級擺在共振 f₀ 以上的傳遞率 ≈ (f₀/f)²：f₀ = 0.5 Hz 時在 10 Hz 為 2.5×10⁻³；要達到 10⁻¹⁰ 需要 n 級使 (2.5×10⁻³)ⁿ ≤ 10⁻¹⁰，即 n ≥ 10/2.6 ≈ 3.9，至少四級；六級則給出 (2.5×10⁻³)⁶ ≈ 2.4×10⁻¹⁶ 的理論餘裕。~Required attenuation A = x_ground/x_allowed = 10⁻⁹/10⁻¹⁹ = 10¹⁰ at 10 Hz. One pendulum stage transmits ≈ (f₀/f)² above its resonance: with f₀ = 0.5 Hz that is 2.5×10⁻³ at 10 Hz; reaching 10⁻¹⁰ needs n stages with (2.5×10⁻³)ⁿ ≤ 10⁻¹⁰, that is n ≥ 10/2.6 ≈ 3.9, at least four, while six stages give a theoretical margin of (2.5×10⁻³)⁶ ≈ 2.4×10⁻¹⁶.
units.verify: 以站址地震計記錄一年中安靜與風暴日的地面位移譜，建立 10%、50%、90% 百分位曲線；把它乘以隔振系統的量測傳遞函數，與干涉儀中測試質量的實際殘餘運動（由控制訊號反推）比較，兩者在 1–10 Hz 應一致，否則存在未建模的耦合路徑。~Record ground-displacement spectra on quiet and stormy days through a year with the site seismometers and build 10th, 50th and 90th percentile curves; multiply them by the measured transfer function of the isolation system and compare with the actual residual test-mass motion inferred from control signals, which should agree between 1 and 10 Hz, otherwise an unmodelled coupling path exists.
units.failure: 冬季風暴期間海洋微震升高十倍，若控制迴路的動態範圍是依安靜日設計，致動器飽和、干涉儀反覆失鎖，工作週期在一週內從 80% 掉到 40%，而靈敏度曲線本身看似正常。~During winter storms the ocean microseism rises tenfold; if the control loops' dynamic range was designed for quiet days, the actuators saturate, the interferometer loses lock repeatedly and the duty cycle drops from 80% to 40% within a week while the sensitivity curve itself looks normal.
units.misconception: 地震雜訊只在地震發生時才重要。~Seismic noise only matters when an earthquake happens.

units.anchor: 倒立擺與機械濾波器鏈~Inverted pendulum and mechanical-filter chain
units.title: 超級衰減器：倒立擺與磁性反彈簧濾波器~The superattenuator: inverted pendulum and magnetic anti-spring filters
units.mechanism: 超級衰減器高約 9 m：頂端是三根彈性接頭支撐的倒立擺，把水平共振頻率調到數十毫赫茲作為預隔離並提供低頻主動控制的介面；其下串接數級機械濾波器，每級以鋼製刀口懸吊提供水平擺動隔離，並以磁性反彈簧把垂直共振壓到 0.4 Hz 以下，解決垂直振動透過地球曲率與機械耦合漏進水平方向的問題；最下方是操縱盤（marionette）、反作用質量與鏡子。整條鏈以被動方式在 10 Hz 以上提供超過十個數量級的衰減，主動控制只負責抑制共振與低頻漂移。~The superattenuator is about 9 m tall: at the top an inverted pendulum on three flexural joints tunes the horizontal resonance to tens of millihertz as pre-isolation and the interface for low-frequency active control; below it hang several mechanical filters, each suspended on steel blades for horizontal pendulum isolation and fitted with magnetic anti-springs that push the vertical resonance below 0.4 Hz, addressing vertical vibration that leaks into the horizontal direction through Earth curvature and mechanical coupling; at the bottom are the marionette, the reaction mass and the mirror. The whole chain provides more than ten orders of magnitude of passive attenuation above 10 Hz, while active control only damps resonances and low-frequency drift.
units.model: 倒立擺的角頻率 ω² = k/M − g/L：腿長 L = 6 m 時 g/L = 1.635 s⁻²，要得到 f = 0.03 Hz（ω² = 0.0355 s⁻²）需 k/M = 1.671 s⁻²，即彈性接頭剛度只能比重力反彈簧大 2.2%，靠配重微調。衰減：倒立擺在 10 Hz 給 (0.03/10)² = 9×10⁻⁶，五級 0.4 Hz 濾波器給 (0.4/10)¹⁰ ≈ 1×10⁻¹⁴，理論乘積約 10⁻¹⁹；實際受交叉耦合限制在 10⁻¹² 等級。~The inverted pendulum's angular frequency obeys ω² = k/M − g/L: with leg length L = 6 m, g/L = 1.635 s⁻², and reaching f = 0.03 Hz (ω² = 0.0355 s⁻²) needs k/M = 1.671 s⁻², so the flexure stiffness may exceed the gravitational anti-spring by only 2.2%, trimmed with counterweights. Attenuation: the inverted pendulum gives (0.03/10)² = 9×10⁻⁶ at 10 Hz, five 0.4 Hz filters give (0.4/10)¹⁰ ≈ 1×10⁻¹⁴, a theoretical product near 10⁻¹⁹; in practice cross-couplings limit it to the 10⁻¹² level.
units.verify: 在組裝時以加速度計與位移感測器量每一級的水平與垂直傳遞函數，確認倒立擺與濾波器的共振頻率；整鏈完成後在頂端施加已知的正弦激振，在鏡子端以光學槓桿或干涉儀量殘餘運動，繪出 0.1–100 Hz 的衰減曲線並與模型比較，特別檢查垂直到水平的耦合比例。~During assembly measure the horizontal and vertical transfer functions of each stage with accelerometers and displacement sensors, confirming the resonances of the inverted pendulum and filters; once the chain is complete apply a known sinusoidal excitation at the top, measure the residual motion at the mirror with an optical lever or the interferometer, plot the attenuation from 0.1 to 100 Hz against the model and check the vertical-to-horizontal coupling ratio in particular.
units.failure: 一級濾波器的磁性反彈簧因溫度變化而偏離工作點，垂直共振從 0.4 Hz 升到 1 Hz 以上，該級垂直隔離退化百倍，經耦合漏進水平方向後在 10–20 Hz 出現原本不存在的雜訊平台。~If a filter's magnetic anti-spring drifts off its working point with temperature, its vertical resonance rises from 0.4 Hz to above 1 Hz, that stage's vertical isolation degrades a hundredfold and, after coupling into the horizontal direction, a noise plateau appears between 10 and 20 Hz that was never there before.
units.misconception: 倒立擺越高越好，因為擺越長共振頻率越低。~A taller inverted pendulum is always better because a longer pendulum has a lower resonance.

units.anchor: 42 kg 熔融石英鏡與 CO₂ 熱補償系統~42 kg fused-silica mirrors and CO₂ thermal-compensation system
units.title: 鏡面、單體懸吊與熱補償~Mirrors, monolithic suspension and thermal compensation
units.mechanism: Advanced Virgo 的測試質量是直徑 35 cm、厚 20 cm、重 42 kg 的熔融石英鏡，以熔融石英纖維從操縱盤單體懸吊，鍍膜由里昂的 LMA 完成。臂內數十到數百 kW 的功率即使只被鍍膜吸收不到 1 ppm，也會在鏡面中心形成溫度梯度，透過 dn/dT 在輸入鏡基板產生熱透鏡、並使鏡面曲率改變，破壞循環腔的模式匹配。熱補償系統用 CO₂ 雷射在補償板上投射環狀加熱圖案，並以環形加熱器微調鏡面曲率，把熱透鏡抵消到設計公差內。~Advanced Virgo's test masses are fused-silica mirrors 35 cm across, 20 cm thick and 42 kg, hung monolithically from the marionette by fused-silica fibres, with coatings made at LMA in Lyon. Tens to hundreds of kilowatts in the arms, even with coating absorption below 1 ppm, create a temperature gradient at the mirror centre that forms a thermal lens in the input-mirror substrate through dn/dT and changes the surface curvature, spoiling the mode matching of the recycling cavities. The thermal compensation system projects ring-shaped heating patterns from CO₂ lasers onto compensation plates and trims mirror curvature with ring heaters, cancelling the thermal lens to within the design tolerance.
units.model: 薄碟熱透鏡焦距近似 f_th ≈ π·κ·w²/(P_abs·dn/dT)。取熔融石英 κ = 1.38 W/(m·K)、dn/dT = 1.2×10⁻⁵/K、光斑半徑 w = 5 cm、臂內 100 kW 被鍍膜吸收 0.5 ppm 得 P_abs = 50 mW：f_th ≈ π×1.38×2.5×10⁻³/(0.05×1.2×10⁻⁵) ≈ 0.0108/6×10⁻⁷ ≈ 1.8×10⁴ m。對邊際穩定的循環腔，18 km 的透鏡已足以改變腔的高斯模態，所以補償必須把等效焦距推到數百 km 以上。~The thin-disk thermal-lens focal length is approximately f_th ≈ π·κ·w²/(P_abs·dn/dT). With fused silica κ = 1.38 W/(m·K), dn/dT = 1.2×10⁻⁵/K, spot radius w = 5 cm and P_abs = 50 mW from 100 kW in the arm absorbed at 0.5 ppm by the coating: f_th ≈ π×1.38×2.5×10⁻³/(0.05×1.2×10⁻⁵) ≈ 0.0108/6×10⁻⁷ ≈ 1.8×10⁴ m. For a marginally stable recycling cavity an 18 km lens already changes the cavity's Gaussian mode, so compensation must push the effective focal length beyond several hundred kilometres.
units.verify: 以 Hartmann 波前感測器透過輸入鏡量熱透鏡的光程差分佈，隨功率提升記錄曲率變化；開啟熱補償後確認殘餘光程差低於數十奈米，並以循環腔的高階模態含量（由相機看模式形狀）與循環增益回升來佐證。~Measure the optical-path-difference map of the thermal lens through the input mirror with a Hartmann wavefront sensor, logging the curvature change as power rises; after enabling thermal compensation confirm that the residual optical path is below tens of nanometres, supported by the higher-order-mode content of the recycling cavity (mode shape on a camera) and the recovery of recycling gain.
units.failure: 一面輸入鏡的點吸收缺陷使局部吸收升高，熱透鏡不再是軸對稱，環狀 CO₂ 加熱圖案無法抵消，循環腔內出現高階模態、增益下降且控制訊號出現偏移；只有加大補償功率反而讓整體熱雜訊升高。~A point-absorber defect on one input mirror raises local absorption so the thermal lens is no longer axisymmetric; the ring-shaped CO₂ pattern cannot cancel it, higher-order modes appear in the recycling cavity, gain drops and control signals pick up offsets; simply raising the compensation power only increases overall thermal noise.
units.misconception: 鍍膜吸收不到 1 ppm，所以熱效應可以忽略。~With coating absorption under 1 ppm, thermal effects are negligible.

units.anchor: 站址密度起伏與牛頓雜訊模型~Site density fluctuations and the Newtonian-noise model
units.title: 牛頓雜訊、散射光與環境耦合~Newtonian noise, scattered light and environmental coupling
units.mechanism: 地面的地震波使附近岩土的密度分佈隨時間變化，對測試質量產生直接的重力擾動，這種牛頓雜訊無法用任何機械隔振擋住，只能靠地震計陣列估算並從資料中減除，或把偵測器建在地下。對 Virgo 而言，牛頓雜訊在 10–20 Hz 與懸吊熱雜訊、控制雜訊同為低頻的邊界；此外散射光從真空管壁或擋板回到主光束會以非線性方式注入相位雜訊，磁場起伏則透過致動器磁鐵耦合，這些環境項都要以感測器陣列監測並計算耦合係數。~Seismic waves make the density distribution of nearby soil and rock vary in time, which perturbs the test masses gravitationally; this Newtonian noise cannot be blocked by any mechanical isolation and can only be estimated with seismometer arrays and subtracted from the data, or avoided by going underground. For Virgo, Newtonian noise at 10–20 Hz shares the low-frequency boundary with suspension thermal and control noise; in addition, light scattered from tube walls or baffles that returns into the main beam injects phase noise nonlinearly, and magnetic-field fluctuations couple through the actuator magnets, so each environmental term is monitored with sensor arrays and assigned a measured coupling coefficient.
units.model: 表面波牛頓雜訊的量級估計 h_NN ≈ [4πGρ/(L·(2πf)²)]·ξ(f)·β，β 為量級為 1 的幾何因子。取 ρ = 1800 kg/m³、G = 6.67×10⁻¹¹ 得 4πGρ ≈ 1.5×10⁻⁶ s⁻²；f = 10 Hz 時 (2πf)² ≈ 3950，地面位移 ξ = 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz：h_NN ≈ 1.5×10⁻⁶/3950×10⁻⁹/3000 ≈ 1.3×10⁻²²/√Hz；f = 20 Hz、ξ = 3×10⁻¹⁰ 時約 1×10⁻²³/√Hz。~An order-of-magnitude surface-wave Newtonian noise is h_NN ≈ [4πGρ/(L·(2πf)²)]·ξ(f)·β, with β a geometric factor of order 1. With ρ = 1800 kg/m³ and G = 6.67×10⁻¹¹, 4πGρ ≈ 1.5×10⁻⁶ s⁻²; at f = 10 Hz, (2πf)² ≈ 3950 and ground displacement ξ = 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz give h_NN ≈ 1.5×10⁻⁶/3950×10⁻⁹/3000 ≈ 1.3×10⁻²²/√Hz; at f = 20 Hz with ξ = 3×10⁻¹⁰ it is about 1×10⁻²³/√Hz.
units.verify: 在末端站周圍布設數十台地震計，量地震波的相干長度與傳播方向，用維納濾波從應變資料中估算可減除的牛頓雜訊比例；散射光則以人為搖晃擋板或真空管區段的方式注入，觀察應變譜中出現的拱形特徵並算出耦合係數。~Deploy tens of seismometers around the end stations, measure the coherence length and propagation direction of seismic waves and use Wiener filtering to estimate the fraction of Newtonian noise that can be subtracted from the strain data; for scattered light, shake a baffle or a tube section deliberately, watch the arch-shaped features that appear in the strain spectrum and compute the coupling coefficient.
units.failure: 末端站附近的機房風扇或鄰近道路產生 10–20 Hz 的地面振動，透過牛頓耦合與散射光同時進入資料，而且兩者耦合係數隨鏡子位置變化；若只依賴單一地震計做減除，剩餘的非穩態雜訊會產生假的短暫訊號。~Fans in an equipment room or traffic on a nearby road produce 10–20 Hz ground vibration that enters the data through Newtonian coupling and scattered light at once, with coupling coefficients that change with mirror position; relying on a single seismometer for subtraction leaves non-stationary residuals that mimic short transient signals.
units.misconception: 只要隔振做得夠好，所有地面相關的雜訊都能消除。~Good enough isolation removes every ground-related noise.

units.title: 校正：光子校正器與牛頓校正器~Calibration: photon calibrator and Newtonian calibrator
units.mechanism: Virgo 除了以輻射壓推動末端鏡的光子校正器，還發展牛頓校正器（NCal）：在末端鏡外數公尺處放置內含偏心質量的轉子，以穩定轉速旋轉，對鏡子產生頻率為轉速兩倍的重力作用力，其大小只由質量、幾何與萬有引力常數決定，不經過任何光學或電子鏈路，是與光子校正器完全獨立的絕對刻度。兩種校正器注入不同頻率的連續校正線，離線分析用它們追蹤讀出鏈增益並給出應變資料的振幅、相位與時間不確定度。~Besides a photon calibrator that pushes the end mirror with radiation pressure, Virgo developed the Newtonian calibrator (NCal): a rotor containing eccentric masses placed a few metres from the end mirror spins at a stable rate and exerts on the mirror a gravitational force at twice the rotation frequency, whose magnitude depends only on mass, geometry and the gravitational constant and passes through no optical or electronic chain, giving an absolute scale fully independent of the photon calibrator. The two calibrators inject continuous lines at different frequencies, which offline analysis uses to track readout gain and to state the amplitude, phase and timing uncertainty of the strain data.
units.model: 量級估計：兩個質量 m 在半徑 r 旋轉、距離鏡心 d 的轉子，對質量 M 的鏡子產生二倍頻力 F ≈ 3GMm·r²/d⁴。取 M = 42 kg、m = 1 kg、r = 0.1 m、d = 1.7 m：F ≈ 3×6.67×10⁻¹¹×42×0.01/8.35 ≈ 1.0×10⁻¹¹ N。轉速 18 Hz 時力的頻率 36 Hz，鏡子位移 x = F/(M(2πf)²) = 1.0×10⁻¹¹/(42×5.1×10⁴) ≈ 4.7×10⁻¹⁸ m，應變 h = x/L ≈ 1.6×10⁻²¹，比 36 Hz 處的雜訊高一個數量級以上，可做為清楚的校正線。~Order of magnitude: a rotor with two masses m at radius r, a distance d from the mirror centre, exerts on a mirror of mass M a force at twice the rotation frequency of F ≈ 3GMm·r²/d⁴. With M = 42 kg, m = 1 kg, r = 0.1 m and d = 1.7 m: F ≈ 3×6.67×10⁻¹¹×42×0.01/8.35 ≈ 1.0×10⁻¹¹ N. At 18 Hz rotation the force is at 36 Hz, the mirror moves x = F/(M(2πf)²) = 1.0×10⁻¹¹/(42×5.1×10⁴) ≈ 4.7×10⁻¹⁸ m and the strain is h = x/L ≈ 1.6×10⁻²¹, more than an order of magnitude above the noise at 36 Hz, a clear calibration line.
units.verify: 同時以光子校正器與牛頓校正器在相近頻率注入，比較兩者推得的應變振幅，差異應在 2% 內；改變轉子到鏡子的距離 d 並確認訊號按 d⁻⁴ 變化，再以多個轉速驗證頻率響應與自由質量模型一致，最後把兩套校正的不確定度寫入校正報告。~Inject with the photon and Newtonian calibrators at nearby frequencies at the same time and compare the strain amplitudes each implies, which should agree within 2%; change the rotor-to-mirror distance d and confirm the signal scales as d⁻⁴, then verify at several rotation speeds that the frequency response follows the free-mass model, and record the uncertainties of both calibrations in the calibration report.
units.failure: 轉子安裝位置量錯 2 cm（d 從 1.70 m 變成 1.72 m）會讓預期力偏差約 5%，若無人復核幾何量測，整個運行的應變刻度帶有同樣的系統誤差，事件的光度距離估計跟著偏差。~A rotor position measured 2 cm wrong (d of 1.72 m instead of 1.70 m) biases the expected force by about 5%; without a second check of the geometry, the strain scale of the whole run carries the same systematic error and the luminosity distances of events are biased with it.
units.misconception: 重力太弱，不可能用它來校正干涉儀。~Gravity is far too weak to calibrate an interferometer with.

units.anchor: 1.2 m 真空管與 150 °C 烘烤~1.2 m vacuum tubes and 150 °C bake-out
units.title: 超高真空、殘氣相位雜訊與基礎設施~Ultra-high vacuum, residual-gas phase noise and infrastructure
units.mechanism: Virgo 的兩條 3 km 真空管直徑 1.2 m，總體積約數千立方公尺，是歐洲最大的超高真空系統之一；管壁經過約 150 °C 的烘烤以釋出氫氣，再由渦輪分子泵、離子泵與管端的低溫捕集器維持 10⁻⁹ mbar 等級的壓力。殘留分子以熱速度穿越光束時，其極化率使局部折射率隨機起伏，造成與分子數密度平方根成正比的相位雜訊；壓力每升高百倍，此雜訊升高十倍，因此真空是靈敏度的直接組成部分，而非只是避免散射的附帶條件。~Virgo's two 3 km vacuum tubes are 1.2 m in diameter with a total volume of several thousand cubic metres, one of the largest ultra-high-vacuum systems in Europe; the walls were baked at about 150 °C to release hydrogen, and turbomolecular pumps, ion pumps and cryogenic traps at the tube ends hold pressures at the 10⁻⁹ mbar level. Residual molecules crossing the beam at thermal speed carry a polarisability that makes the local refractive index fluctuate randomly, producing phase noise proportional to the square root of the number density; every hundredfold rise in pressure raises this noise tenfold, so the vacuum is a direct component of sensitivity rather than a mere precaution against scatter.
units.model: 殘氣相位雜訊的近似式 S_x ≈ 4(2πα)²·n·L/(v₀·w)，α 為分子極化率體積、n 為數密度、v₀ 為熱速度、w 為光束半徑。H₂ 在 10⁻⁹ mbar（10⁻⁷ Pa、295 K）時 n = p/(kT) ≈ 2.5×10¹³ m⁻³，α ≈ 8×10⁻³¹ m³，v₀ ≈ 1.6×10³ m/s，w = 0.05 m，L = 3000 m：S_x ≈ 4×(5×10⁻³⁰)²×2.5×10¹³×3000/(1.6×10³×0.05) ≈ 1×10⁻⁴³ m²/Hz，√S_x ≈ 3×10⁻²² m/√Hz，h ≈ 1×10⁻²⁵/√Hz；若壓力升到 10⁻⁶ mbar 則乘以 √1000 ≈ 32，達 3×10⁻²⁴，已與設計靈敏度同量級。~An approximate residual-gas phase noise is S_x ≈ 4(2πα)²·n·L/(v₀·w), with α the molecular polarisability volume, n the number density, v₀ the thermal speed and w the beam radius. For H₂ at 10⁻⁹ mbar (10⁻⁷ Pa, 295 K), n = p/(kT) ≈ 2.5×10¹³ m⁻³, α ≈ 8×10⁻³¹ m³, v₀ ≈ 1.6×10³ m/s, w = 0.05 m and L = 3000 m: S_x ≈ 4×(5×10⁻³⁰)²×2.5×10¹³×3000/(1.6×10³×0.05) ≈ 1×10⁻⁴³ m²/Hz, so √S_x ≈ 3×10⁻²² m/√Hz and h ≈ 1×10⁻²⁵/√Hz; at 10⁻⁶ mbar multiply by √1000 ≈ 32 to reach 3×10⁻²⁴, already comparable with the design sensitivity.
units.verify: 以殘氣分析儀（RGA）量各管段的氣體組成，確認 H₂ 為主而碳氫化合物極低；記錄烘烤前後的出氣率與壓力曲線，並在觀測期間監測壓力與應變雜訊的相關性，例如刻意暫停一台泵使壓力升高十倍，應變譜在高頻應上升約 √10 ≈ 3.2 倍。~Measure the gas composition of each tube section with a residual-gas analyser, confirming hydrogen dominance and very low hydrocarbons; log outgassing rates and pressure curves before and after bake-out, and during observation monitor the correlation between pressure and strain noise, for example by pausing one pump so pressure rises tenfold, when the high-frequency strain spectrum should rise by about √10 ≈ 3.2.
units.failure: 一個閥門墊圈的微漏讓空氣進入某段真空管，壓力從 10⁻⁹ 升到 10⁻⁷ mbar，殘氣雜訊升高十倍並在高頻形成平台，同時水氣沉積到鏡面提高散射；若監測只看總壓而不看組成，漏氣與出氣會被混淆而延誤修復。~A micro-leak at a valve gasket lets air into one tube section and the pressure rises from 10⁻⁹ to 10⁻⁷ mbar; residual-gas noise grows tenfold and forms a high-frequency plateau while water deposits on the mirrors and raises scatter. Monitoring only total pressure rather than composition confuses a leak with outgassing and delays the repair.
units.misconception: 真空只是為了避免灰塵與空氣散射，對雜訊曲線沒有直接貢獻。~Vacuum only keeps dust and air scatter away and has no direct place in the noise curve.

units.anchor: 三站網路時間延遲與運行交接~Three-detector time delays and run handoff
units.title: 網路觀測、天區定位與工程交接~Network observing, sky localisation and engineering handoff
units.mechanism: Virgo 的科學價值很大一部分來自與兩座 LIGO 組成的三站網路：訊號到達三站的時間差決定波源在天上的位置，三站的振幅比與相位差再縮小區域並給出極化資訊。2017 年 8 月的雙中子星事件 GW170817 正是因為加入 Virgo 才把定位縮到約 30 平方度，使光學望遠鏡能找到對應的電磁訊號。運行交接因此包含與其他站共享的校正模型、GPS 對時、資料品質旗標與低延遲警報鏈，而不僅是本站的靈敏度紀錄。~Much of Virgo's scientific value comes from forming a three-detector network with the two LIGO sites: the arrival-time differences fix the source position on the sky, and the amplitude ratios and phase differences between sites shrink the region further and give polarisation information. The binary-neutron-star event GW170817 in August 2017 was localised to about 30 square degrees only because Virgo was part of the network, which let optical telescopes find its electromagnetic counterpart. Run handoff therefore includes the calibration model shared with the other sites, GPS timing, data-quality flags and the low-latency alert chain, not only the local sensitivity record.
units.model: 到達時間的量測精度 σ_t ≈ 1/(2π·SNR·σ_f)，σ_f 為訊號的有效頻寬：SNR = 10、σ_f = 100 Hz 時 σ_t ≈ 1.6×10⁻⁴ s。Virgo 與漢福德相距約 8000 km（光程約 27 ms），角度精度 σ_θ ≈ c·σ_t/D ≈ 3×10⁸×1.6×10⁻⁴/8×10⁶ ≈ 6×10⁻³ rad ≈ 0.34°；兩條獨立基線使定位區域縮到數平方度到數十平方度，若只有兩站則退化為跨越數百平方度的環帶。~Arrival-time precision is σ_t ≈ 1/(2π·SNR·σ_f), with σ_f the effective signal bandwidth: for SNR = 10 and σ_f = 100 Hz, σ_t ≈ 1.6×10⁻⁴ s. Virgo and Hanford are about 8000 km apart (a light-travel time of about 27 ms), so the angular precision is σ_θ ≈ c·σ_t/D ≈ 3×10⁸×1.6×10⁻⁴/8×10⁶ ≈ 6×10⁻³ rad ≈ 0.34°; two independent baselines shrink the sky region to between a few and tens of square degrees, whereas two sites alone leave a ring spanning hundreds of square degrees.
units.verify: 以 GPS 鎖定的時間標記做端到端時序測試：在三站注入相同波形並設定已知的時間差，確認分析管線回復的時間差誤差小於 10 µs；運行前以模擬事件演練低延遲警報，量從資料到警報發出的延遲，並把校正不確定度、時序誤差與警報延遲列入網路交接紀錄。~Run an end-to-end timing test with GPS-locked time stamps: inject the same waveform at the three sites with known time offsets and confirm that the analysis pipeline recovers the offsets to better than 10 µs; before the run rehearse low-latency alerts with simulated events, measure the delay from data to alert and enter calibration uncertainty, timing error and alert latency in the network handoff record.
units.failure: 某站的時間標記因 GPS 接收機韌體更新而偏移 1 ms，天區定位整體平移數度，電磁對應體的搜尋指向錯誤的天區；由於各站各自的靈敏度與校正都正常，錯誤只能靠網路層級的時序測試發現。~A 1 ms offset in one site's time stamps after a GPS-receiver firmware update shifts the sky localisation by several degrees and sends electromagnetic follow-up to the wrong region; because each site's sensitivity and calibration look normal, only a network-level timing test can reveal the error.
units.misconception: 三站的靈敏度加總才是重點，定位只是附帶的好處。~What matters is the summed sensitivity of three sites; localisation is just a side benefit.

example: 超級衰減器隔振預算練習（教學假設）：10 Hz 的地面位移 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz。倒立擺調到 0.04 Hz，傳遞率 (0.04/10)² = 1.6×10⁻⁵；五級機械濾波器各 0.4 Hz，傳遞率 (0.4/10)¹⁰ = 1.05×10⁻¹⁴；理論總衰減 1.7×10⁻¹⁹，鏡子水平殘餘 1.7×10⁻²⁸ m/√Hz。實際上交叉耦合把衰減限制在約 10⁻¹²，殘餘 10⁻²¹ m/√Hz，對應 h = 10⁻²¹/3000 ≈ 3.3×10⁻²⁵/√Hz，仍比 10 Hz 處約 10⁻²³ 的設計目標低 30 倍。垂直方向：若垂直殘餘也為 10⁻²¹ m/√Hz，地球曲率使兩端局部鉛垂線相差 L/R_E = 3000/6.37×10⁶ ≈ 4.7×10⁻⁴ rad，加上機械失準取總耦合 1%，水平等效為 10⁻²³ m/√Hz，可忽略。結論是 10 Hz 的真正邊界不是地震而是懸吊熱雜訊、控制雜訊與牛頓雜訊。數值為教學假設。~Superattenuator isolation-budget exercise (teaching assumptions): ground displacement at 10 Hz is 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz. The inverted pendulum tuned to 0.04 Hz transmits (0.04/10)² = 1.6×10⁻⁵; five mechanical filters at 0.4 Hz each transmit (0.4/10)¹⁰ = 1.05×10⁻¹⁴; the theoretical total attenuation is 1.7×10⁻¹⁹ and the residual horizontal mirror motion 1.7×10⁻²⁸ m/√Hz. In practice cross-couplings cap the attenuation near 10⁻¹², leaving 10⁻²¹ m/√Hz, or h = 10⁻²¹/3000 ≈ 3.3×10⁻²⁵/√Hz, still 30 times below the design target of about 10⁻²³ at 10 Hz. Vertically: if the vertical residual is also 10⁻²¹ m/√Hz, Earth curvature makes the local verticals at the two ends differ by L/R_E = 3000/6.37×10⁶ ≈ 4.7×10⁻⁴ rad, and taking 1% total coupling including mechanical misalignment gives a horizontal equivalent of 10⁻²³ m/√Hz, negligible. The conclusion is that the real boundary at 10 Hz is not seismic motion but suspension thermal, control and Newtonian noise. Values are teaching assumptions.
history: Virgo 由 Adalberto Giazotto 與 Alain Brillet 於 1987 年提出，1989 年向法國 CNRS 與義大利 INFN 提案並於 1990 年代初獲准，1997 年在比薩附近的卡希納動工、2003 年落成，2000 年成立歐洲重力觀測站（EGO）負責營運；2007 年開始科學觀測並與 LIGO 簽署聯合運作協議。Advanced Virgo 升級於 2017 年完成，隨即在 2017 年 8 月 14 日參與 GW170814 的三站偵測，三天後的 GW170817 開啟多信使天文學；之後的升級加入訊號循環與頻率相依壓縮光。本課只重建公開文獻中的工程原理。~Virgo was proposed by Adalberto Giazotto and Alain Brillet in 1987, submitted to France's CNRS and Italy's INFN in 1989 and approved in the early 1990s; construction at Cascina near Pisa began in 1997, the detector was inaugurated in 2003, and the European Gravitational Observatory (EGO) was founded in 2000 to operate it; science observations began in 2007 together with a joint-operation agreement with LIGO. The Advanced Virgo upgrade was completed in 2017 and the detector joined the three-site detection of GW170814 on 14 August 2017, followed three days later by GW170817, which opened multi-messenger astronomy; later upgrades added signal recycling and frequency-dependent squeezing. This course reconstructs only engineering principles found in public literature.
